description: How a player's 2025-26 stat line becomes the four skater ratings (0 to 1) and the goalie rating the engine uses. Every rating is a clamp(base + weighted per-game rates). Edit the weights here; the engine recomputes on load.

shoot.drives: shot accuracy, shot speed, willingness to shoot, one-timer quality

pass.drives: pass accuracy, willingness to move the puck

def.drives: steal rate, shot-block rate, zone coverage

overall: mean of shoot, pass, def, skate; used for faceoffs and puck protection

goalie.drives: width of the goalie line, save probability

notes: Players with under 10 games are regressed toward a 10-game baseline so a 2-game sample does not produce extreme ratings.
Plus-minus is a weak defensive proxy; a production version should replace it with on-ice expected-goals against or similar.
precedence: When data/moneypuck-2025.json has an entry for a player, its ratings (shoot, pass, def, faceoff, penaltiesPer60) replace the shoot/pass/def formulas below; skate still comes from the formula below. Goalies with MoneyPuck tier data use tier save percentages instead of the single-number goalie rating.
